data.description:
The game provides swords, magic, and firearms in three combat ways; players can use any combination of them to form their own unique fighting style and clever use of different ways to fight with the enemy. Players need to observe different enemy fighting ways to make different combat changes after a long time of training and combat to grow into a qualified "Subspace hunter" to protect our reality plane.

Hand Tracing：
  The game supports full hand tracking interaction to play, and Trigger skills by recognizing different gestures. At the same time, while hand tracing, players can use blades and guns to fight.

Melee system:
   Players can use the blade to block, bounce, parry enemy attacks, and intercept enemy bullets and orbs.

changelog.change_log:
Gameplay changes
1. The player's HP has been increased to 200
2. Turn off the Sword Skill system
3. 50% of the gun reload time
5. Added bullet visualization for enemies and players
6. Basic monster HP increased by 50%
7. High-level monster damage increased by 25%, boss damage increased by 50%
8. Players can intercept enemy bullets

Bug fixes and system optimizations
1. Optimized the detection of firearm reload action
2. Optimized the loading time of the scene, reducing the loading time from 4 seconds to 1.5 seconds
3. The gaze time required for retrieving items has been changed from 7 seconds to 3 seconds
4. Fixed the bug that the enemy was floating when walking

Art asset modifications and upgrades
1. King's Guard has been renamed: Flower Kinght, upgraded the model and FX effects, optimized the weapon wielding sound effect, and added a walking sound effect
2. Upgraded the model of Crazy Pork
3. Added basic enemy: Lizardman Soldier
4. Upgraded the model of Human Hunter
5. Fist of the North has been renamed: Martial Arts Master, and the model has been upgraded
6. Upgraded the model of electroshock therapy
7. Optimized the FX effect of DarkElveLord, and optimized the problem of clipping of the combined action weapon
8. Upgraded the model of Dead Dog, and optimized the FX effect

UI system
Changed the effect of the transparency of the system menu to a white background + gray logo
